summary: Process for teachers to provide structured feedback for students, including a title, type, category, description, and optional attachments. Feedback can be marked as private or open.
steps: Use the filter options to select the specific class or view all classes' data.
Select the student for whom feedback is to be given.
Choose the visibility option: 'Open Private' (visible to other teachers in feedback reports) or 'Private' (visible only to the teacher who gave it).
Select the 'Feedback Type' (e.g., Positive, Negative, Neutral) from the dropdown.
Select the 'Feedback Category' (e.g., Academic Performance, Sports, Behavior) from the dropdown.
Select 'Send Notification' if the feedback should be visible on the student's app.
business_rules: Feedback types and categories must be pre-configured in 'Institute Setup' before they can be used.
Students can view their feedback on the student app if the 'Send Notification' option is selected.
important_notes: 'Open Private' feedback is shared among teachers, while 'Private' feedback remains confidential to the giver.
Feedback provided is recorded on the student's timeline, accessible through their profile.
